item.name: 62ft Island Boat SD: 📍San Diego (Sunset Duo)
item.description:
🏝️💦🍹Ahoy!
Looking for a 🛥️🥂vibey yacht with a HUGE 🎉party deck to celebrate your 🥳special occasion? Look no further!

Turn ANY occasion (Anniversary, Birthday, Bachelor/Bachelorette, Corporate Event, Engagement, Gender Reveal, Memorial at Sea, Wedding) into a 🥂🍾celebration aboard your own private yacht-for-a-day with...

#🌴Tours🌴
💦🛥️CHOOSE Your Adventure OR POINT & GO!
*Tour adventures are WEATHER PERMITTING and to be discussed with Captain upon boarding. We cruise Rain or Shine unless extreme or dangerous.*

1. (2 Hours) 🛥Cruise San Diego Bay, 🌇Tour the Downtown San Diego Skyline, See Embarcadero Park, Get up-close and underneath the USS Midway flight deck, See the Rady Shell Amphitheatre and Pass through the arches of the 🌉Coronado Bridge!

2. (3-4 Hours) 🛥Bay Cruise + ⚓️Drop Anchor & Party at Sea near the 🤩World Famous 🌉Coronado Bridge!

#🌴Activities🌴
 💦🛥️While cruising OR at ⚓Anchor... 
👙 SWIM
😎 LAY out
🍹 SHAKE cocktails
♨️ GRILL out
🧀 EAT charcuterie
🎤🎶 SING karaoke
💃 VIBE on the dance floor
🏀 WATCH live sports
🌇 ENJOY the Views
AND... during the cruise we often see 🦭 Sea Lions and sometimes even 🐬Dolphins or 🐳Whales!

#🤩Promo Price?
Click Calendar date for price. *2 hour minimum, so you can experience EVERYTHING the Bay and Boat has to offer. 13 people max. Total Price is the same with 13 people or less. Book now with a 50% deposit and pay balance later!* 🥳

#🤗🎉What’s Indicated in Price?
1. Yacht rental
2. 👨‍✈️USCG Captain
3. 👨‍✈️Deckhand
4. ⛽️Fuel
5. Insurance
6. Port fees
7. WiFi
8. 🏈(2) TVs with LIVE Sports
9. 🎤Karaoke system
10. Large Kitchen & Bathroom
11. 💧Filtered Water
12. 🥤Flavored Sparkling Water
13. 🫖Tea
14. ☕️Espresso
15. Cups
16.🧉TIKI Mugs
17. Straws
18. 🍽️Plates
19. 🍴Utensils
20. Napkins
21. Shot Glasses & Cocktail Shakers
22. 💦👙HUGE Floating Lilly Pad🏊‍♀️🛟
23. 🧊HUGE Ice Chest
24. 🎼Surround Sound Bluetooth Speakers

#🤗What To Bring?
- Food & Snacks
- Alcoholic Beverages
- Warm Layers
- Towel
- Swimsuit

🛥️Our cruising speed is 5 knots, so we are for drinking fast and driving slow. You may instruct the Captain & Crew of your preferred route, activities, get recommendations and make changes at anytime while underway. Please bring CASH Gratuity for Captain and Crew, we suggest 15%-20% for excellent service, which is industry standard, or no less then $200 total.

#🤗What Are The Yacht Amenities?
- 3 LARGE Entertaining areas:
1. Oversized Party Deck!
2. Chic Interior Salon!
3. Turf Covered Bow!

#- Inside:
2 Staterooms, 2 Bathrooms, Salon with Lounge Chairs, Living Room with Sofa, Tiki Bar, 34" UHD TV Fully Loaded (LIVE Sports, Apple TV, Netflix, etc), 10 Port USB Charging Station, WiFi, Bluetooth Speakers, Alexa, Large Kitchen with Espresso Machine, Fridge, Freezer and Ice Maker. *The Master Stateroom & Bathroom is reserved for overnight stays only.*

#- Outside:
The Top Deck is an Oversized 250/SqFt Lounge, Seating for your entire party, Dance Floor, Bluetooth Speakers, 55" 4K UHD TV, Karaoke System, Tiki Table, Fridge, Wet Bar, 60 Quart Ice Chest, Blue Lights & Galaxy Party Lights Projector.

#- Surround Sound Bluetooth Music:
You control the Music and set the Vibe on surround sound speakers by Bluetooth for 24/7 easy listening of Pandora, Spotify, and Amazon Music.

#- Safety Equipment:
The yacht is US Coast Guard examined and equipped with all USCG required safety equipment, such as, Life Jackets, Life Rings, Fire Extinguishers, VHF Radios, GPS, Flares, Sound Devices, etc.

#🤔Bartender/Server? (Optional Upgrade)
Onboard, you can make yourself at home! If you prefer to have a Bartender serve your food and prepare your beverages to ensure a full luxury experience it is available upon request with a $100 service fee.

#🤔Traeger Wood Fired BBQ? (Optional Upgrade)
Grill your veggies and meats to perfection on the ULTIMATE wood fired grill. The Traeger! Our crew will help set up and breakdown for you and your party to man the grill. Available upon request with a $100 equipment fee.

#🤔Pickup Dock Location?
The Pickup Dock is located at H&M Landing at 2803 Emerson St, San Diego, CA 92106.

#🤔Cancellation Policy?
Cancellations more than 14 days from departure date, 50% refunded of Total Rental. Cancellations less than 14 days from departure date, no refunds. If a charter is canceled due to unsafe weather, 100% refunded or Charterer may reschedule.

#🤔$250 Security Deposit?
A HOLD is placed on your card for the security deposit and is necessary for damages or excessive messes that require additional or professional cleaning.

#🤔Questions?
If you have any questions before booking, we can answer those by ☎️phone before you pay.🥂

#🤔What is a Bareboat Charter?*
*As defined below, the vessel you are booking (Island Boat SD) is a bareboat charter:

1. A bareboat charter is a vessel that is leased by the owner to another person (a “charterer”) for a period of time without a captain or crew.

2. A bareboat charter is a vessel that is considered a recreational vessel and may not be subject to
Passenger Vessel inspections by the United States Coast Guard.

3. Once the charterer takes possession of the vessel, the charterer becomes entirely responsible for any collision, personal injuries and wages for the crew.

4. The owner of the vessel is generally not responsible for any collision, personal injuries and wages for the crew.

5. The charterer is responsible for the vessel’s crew, fuel, insurance, any maintenance or repairs, and any liability associated with use and possession of the vessel.

6. The charterer must have the option of selecting and paying crew and may discharge the master or any crew member without referral to the owner.

7. The owner may require general levels of proficiency for the crew that is retained based on federal statutes, and Charterers and passengers are solely responsible for making sure they understand and agree to the terms of any bareboat charter agreement.

YACHT CHARTER | BOAT RENTAL | SAN DIEGO | PARTY BOAT | 62FT YACHT RENTAL
item.booking_notes:
🌴💦 Ahoy Island Cruiser!
We are thrilled to have you and your guests onboard soon!

#⚠️**3 REQUIRED STEPS TO FINALIZE YOUR BOOKING**⚠️

**1.** **[CLICK HERE NOW to eSign your CHARTER AGREEMENT](https://app.hellosign.com/s/5DCtzy14).**

**2.** **TEXT YOUR PHOTO ID** to us at 310-906-0092.

**3.** **GROUP TEXT** this **PASSENGER WAIVER link** to your guests **NOW**. ALL GUESTS are REQUIRED to ESIGN WAIVER in order to board. ALL GUESTS please have your PASSENGER WAIVER confirmation email OPEN & READY TO SHOW our Crew before your departure time to avoid any delays.**🐳

👉**[Click Here to eSign your “Passenger Waiver”](https://waiver.smartwaiver.com/w/637d44bedacbc/web/).**

🌴🌴🌴**Below is your Checklist of 17 FAQs for a smooth cruise!**🌴🌴🌴

🤔**What To Bring?**
1. 🧥***WARM CLOTHING*** layers.
2. ***TOWEL***.
3. 👙***SWIM SUIT***.
4. 🍕🍹***FOOD, ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGES and 🧊ICE***. (NO RED Drinks, RED Cake or RED Curry)
5. 💵Please bring ***CASH GRATUITY*** as it is not included, *we suggest 15-20% for excellent service as it’s industry standard. You can also pay by Venmo, cash app or Zelle.If you tipped on a card, please disregard as the crew saw it! 🤗

🤔**What Shoes Should I Wear?**
·        NO Shoes are allowed onboard. To protect the boat from damage and dirt please remove and stow your shoes once onboard. We recommend bringing socks if your feet get cold.

🤔**Where Do I Meet the Island Boat SD?**
·        H&M LANDING located at ***2803 Emerson St, San Diego, Ca 92016*** next to Point Loma Seafoods. Please gather and wait at the ***H&M Landing DOCK GATE*** until your Captain and Crew come get you for Island Boat SD.

![DOCK BUILDING](https://cdn.filestackcontent.com/J9eckDqRQC6Exu66BGrw)

![DOCK GATE](https://cdn.filestackcontent.com/OSCHYXGTSjOeVtPq6M61)

🤔**What Time Should I Arrive?**
·       We recommend arriving ***30 minutes EARLY***. The ***Captain will CALL & MEET you at the DOCK GATE when your boat is DOCKED & READY to board***. There may be another party disembarking, so we appreciate your patience while our crew cleans thoroughly before boarding. We will board once your entire party arrives and the boat is ready. IF the boat and crew is running LATE, rest assured you will get your full time.

🤔**What About Parking?**
·        There are parking lots located at and around ***2803 Emerson St, San Diego, CA  92106***. The H&M Landing parking lot can be very busy, so cruise around in the RED mapped area. You can unload your stuff at the round-a-bout in front of H&M first.
![Description of image](https://cdn.filestackcontent.com/twEGd7hdScnNN57VWbSw)

🤔**What If My Party Is Late?**
·       Your cruise time **BEGINS** and **ENDS** according to your booking itinerary… not when you arrive. The Dock requires us to depart within 15 minutes from your scheduled Departure Time. **If you are going to be 15 minutes late please Text or Call us at (310) 906-0092.**

🤔**Can We Extend Our Cruise?**
·        Text or Call us at (310) 906-0092 OR let the Captain or Crew know and we will see if that can be arranged based upon availability of the vessel. The cost will be based on your booked hourly rate.

🤔**Can We Bring Alcohol Aboard Island Boat SD?**
·        It would be weird if you didn't. As long as guests are over 21, you are welcome to bring and drink whatever you like. *Please NO Red wine, NO glass beer bottles allowed.*

🤔**Can We Board Early to 🎈🎉Decorate?**
·         Any decorating and clean up of decorations must be done during your scheduled rental time. We recommend keeping it minimal (a sign and a numbered balloon or two) since the boat is already decorated or booking more time to allow for your decorating.

🤔**Is Island Boat SD Kid-Friendly?**
·        Absolutely, guests of all ages are welcome. If anyone has a tendency to get motion sick or sea sick, please be sure to take something ahead of time.

🤔**Is Island Boat SD Dog-Friendly?**
·        While we love our pups, it is not appropriate to have them aboard while underway for safety and cleanliness. Out of respect to ALL guests, we ask that you leave your furry friend at home, ESA's included.

🤔**Can We Smoke Aboard Island Boat SD?**
·        NO. Just below your seats are 480 gallons of fuel, plus we want to keep the boat nice for a long time to come, and burn holes are hard to repair. ***You may vape responsibly.***

🤔**What About Weed, Man?**
·        Since we will be on federal waters and marijuana is not federally legal, that's a big NO. You can leave the drugs at home... you're going to have a great time without them.
*FYI… The Coast Guard does random safety checks and can board us at anytime.*

🤔**How Many People Can We Have In Our Group?**
·        13 Max as per US Coast Guard and Port of San Diego regulations. The USCG strictly prohibits us from carrying more than 13 guests.

🤔**What Activities & Tours Are There?**
·        A USCG Licensed Captain and Deckhand will be taking care of you and your guests. You can instruct them as to what route you would prefer to take and get recommendations based upon your cruise time for what you’d like to see and do.
·        Cruise San Diego Bay!
·        Tour Downtown San Diego & Embarcadero Park, USS Midway, Rady Shell Amphitheater, & Pass through the arches of the Coronado Bridge!
·        Drop Anchor at Glorietta Bay, Party at Sea & Swim!
·        And of course at anytime… Dance, Karaoke, Lay out, Watch for Seals/Dolphins/Whales, Shake Cocktails, Eat Charcuterie & Enjoy the Downtown San Diego Skyline and Coastal Scene!

🤔**Excessive Messes & Toilets?**
·        ***There is a $250 cleaning fee for excessive messes or clogged toilets.*** Boat Plumbing is EXTREMELY SENSITIVE. Please discard all toilet paper, tissues and tampons in the bathroom trash can. Do not worry… there is a SIGN inside the bathroom as a reminder for you and your guests. Our crew will also remind you during the boarding safety brief.

🤔**Cancellation Policy?**
Cancellations ***more than*** 30 days from departure date, 100% refunded of Total Rental. Cancellations ***less than*** 30 days from departure date, no refunds. If a charter is canceled due to unsafe weather, 100% refunded or Charterer may reschedule.

**If you have any questions don't hesitate to Call/Text us at (310) 906-0092 or email us at IslandBoatSD@gmail.com.**

Happy Cruising! 🥂
January
Island Boat SD
